entry.title: New: RES25-225 (Honolulu) — CCL
entry.content:
ACCEPTING A GIFT OF CASH IN THE AMOUNT OF $3,000.00 FROM FRIENDS OF HONOLULU PARKS AND RECREATION FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF PARKS AND RECREATION TO USE FOR COMMUNITY BENEFIT PROJECTS AND TO PURCHASE RELATED ITEMS LIKE, BUT NOT LIMITED TO, REFRESHMENTS, AWARDS, PRIZES, SUPPLIES, EQUIPMENT, CONTRACTUAL AND OTHER SUPPORT SERVICES, TRANSPORTATION AND CLOTHING, SUCH AS T-SHIRTS AND VISORS FOR PROGRAMS AND/OR EVENTS.

Latest action: Committee report and Resolution were adopted.
